title: Problem
问题
html:
Open reasoning supervision is concentrated in math and code, so students see too few difficult questions from ordinary scientific and social domains.

NATURALREASONING scales domain-diverse question generation, attaches reference answers and named teacher responses, and exposes those records for distillation or self-training. The decision boundary is whether a serialized record survives question-quality judgments, reference-answer checks, reward-model scoring, and self-reward filtering; the direct output is NATURALREASONING, consumed by reasoning SFT, knowledge distillation, and filtered self-training rather than an evaluation-only benchmark.

L4 facts: primary source arXiv:2502.13124; venue/date arXiv preprint (2025); open data NATURALREASONING at https://huggingface.co/datasets/facebook/natural_reasoning; scale 2.8 million questions with reference answers and teacher responses; full paper, official README, terms, schema, and one actual record checked on 2026-07-27.

开放推理监督过度集中于数学和代码，学生模型很少见到科学、经济与社会领域中的困难自然问题。

该工作扩展跨学科问题，附上参考答案与教师长回答，再用质量判断和奖励信号筛选。 判定边界是记录能否通过“问题质量判断、参考答案检查、奖励模型评分与自奖励筛选”并成为推理监督微调、知识蒸馏和过滤式自训练的输入；直接产物是 NATURALREASONING，不是只用于评测的基准。

L4 事实：主要来源为 arXiv:2502.13124，日期与状态为 2025 年预印本；开放数据为 NATURALREASONING，规模是280 万个问题，并附参考答案和教师回答；已于 2026-07-27 核验全文、官方说明、条款、字段和一条实际公开记录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
NATURALREASONING scales domain-diverse question generation, attaches reference answers and named teacher responses, and exposes those records for distillation or self-training. Relative to math- and code-only distillation corpora, it changes the reusable target to question, reference_answer, and a list of response and response_model pairs and makes question-quality judgments, reference-answer checks, reward-model scoring, and self-reward filtering the feedback boundary, so the central contribution is Track 01 data rather than a model-only, verifier-only, or benchmark-only artifact.

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 - Source and normalize the task. Input: seed concepts expanded into diverse, difficult natural questions across many disciplines. Operation: Normalize prompts, source identifiers, media or tools, references, and expected outputs into candidate records. Output and transition: Auditable candidates advance to target generation. Check / stop rule: Reject a candidate when its task input, source, access terms, or required reference is missing.

Step 2 - Write the reusable target. Input: A normalized candidate and its source evidence. Operation: Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and other named teacher models write long responses. Output and transition: The resulting answer, rationale, or tool trace is serialized as question, reference_answer, and a list of response and response_model pairs and advances to verification. Check / stop rule: Stop when the target cannot be linked to its prompt, authoring mechanism, or required environment state.

Step 3 - Verify and package. Input: Generated targets and task-specific correctness metadata. Operation: Apply question-quality judgments, reference-answer checks, reward-model scoring, and self-reward filtering. Output and transition: Passing records form 2.8 million questions with reference answers and teacher responses stored as Parquet records and advance to training. Check / stop rule: Reject failed checks; final-answer agreement alone is not treated as proof that every intermediate step is correct.

Step 4 - Train and evaluate the consumer. Input: The pinned dataset revision and the paper's base checkpoint. Operation: Use the records for reasoning SFT, knowledge distillation, and filtered self-training and compare with math- and code-only distillation corpora. Output and transition: A trained consumer and the paper's controlled evaluation become the final artifacts. Check / stop rule: Pin the data, teacher, tools, prompts, model, seeds, and harness, and do not generalize beyond evaluated domains.

步骤 1：取得并规范任务。输入是由种子概念扩展出的多学科困难自然问题。操作是统一题目、来源、媒体或工具、参考信息与预期输出。输出是可审计候选，随后进入目标生成。检查与停止规则是缺少任务输入、来源、使用条款或必要参考时立即拒绝。

步骤 2：写入可复用目标。输入是规范候选及其来源证据。操作是由Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 等具名教师模型生成长回答。输出是按“问题、参考答案，以及带生成模型标识的回答列表”序列化的答案、推理或工具轨迹，随后进入验证。检查与停止规则是目标无法对应题目、生成机制或必要环境状态时停止。

步骤 3：验证并打包。输入是生成目标与任务专用正确性信息。操作是执行问题质量判断、参考答案检查、奖励模型评分与自奖励筛选。输出是通过检查的280 万个问题，并附参考答案和教师回答，按官方格式保存并进入训练。检查与停止规则是拒绝失败记录，且不把终答一致当作每个中间步骤都正确的证明。

步骤 4：训练并评估消费方。输入是固定版本的数据与论文基础检查点。操作是用于推理监督微调、知识蒸馏和过滤式自训练，并与只覆盖数学和代码的蒸馏语料比较。输出是训练后模型和受控评测。检查与停止规则是固定数据、教师、工具、提示、模型、随机种子与评测器，结论不越过已评估领域。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Decisive downstream experiment: On the paper's matched question-quality evaluation, NATURALREASONING obtains a mean score of 6.45 versus 5.92 for the second-best source, and its distillation studies improve broad reasoning benchmarks. This is evidence for the complete data intervention under the reported training setup, not proof that every released record is correct.

Artifact check: the official release contains 2.8 million questions with reference answers and teacher responses and exposes actual fields question, reference_answer, and a list of response and response_model pairs; on 2026-07-27 its page reported 2001 downloads. Usage is only an impact cross-check, not a causal experiment.

决定性下游实验：在论文的匹配问题质量评估中，该数据源均分为 6.45，第二名为 5.92；蒸馏实验还带来跨领域推理提升。 这只能支持论文报告训练设置下的完整数据干预，不能证明每条公开记录都正确。

产物核验：官方发布包含280 万个问题，并附参考答案和教师回答，实际字段是“问题、参考答案，以及带生成模型标识的回答列表”；2026-07-27 数据页显示 2001 次下载。使用量只作影响交叉检查，不是因果实验。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The closest baseline is math- and code-only distillation corpora. The paper changes the reusable object by making question, reference_answer, and a list of response and response_model pairs explicit and coupling it to question-quality judgments, reference-answer checks, reward-model scoring, and self-reward filtering. That is a direction signal because another team can train reasoning SFT, knowledge distillation, and filtered self-training from the released records. The inherited backbone, source tasks, autoregressive objective, and public benchmarks are not new.
最近基线是只覆盖数学和代码的蒸馏语料。真正变化是把“问题、参考答案，以及带生成模型标识的回答列表”显式化，并与“问题质量判断、参考答案检查、奖励模型评分与自奖励筛选”绑定。另一团队可直接用公开记录训练推理监督微调、知识蒸馏和过滤式自训练，因此它构成数据方向信号。继承的骨干、来源任务、自回归目标和公开基准并不新。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. When reference answers and reward-model scores can accept fluent but unsupported reasoning, the most serious consequence is training on a trace whose apparent correctness does not match its reasoning; reproduce a stratified record-level audit before reuse.
  2. Because synthetic expansion may reproduce teacher biases or uneven domain coverage, downstream gains may not transfer to a new domain or deployment; run source- and domain-specific evaluations rather than relying on the aggregate score.
  3. Reuse must preserve CC-BY-NC-4.0 and every upstream source or media term; exclude records whose provenance or redistribution right cannot be reconstructed.

1. 如果参考答案与奖励模型可能接受流畅但缺少依据的推理，最严重后果是把表面正确但推理不实的轨迹用于训练；复用前应按来源和难度分层抽样复核。
  2. 由于合成扩展可能复制教师偏差，并造成领域覆盖不均，汇总收益未必迁移到新领域或部署环境；应分别运行来源级和领域级评测。
  3. 复用必须遵守 CC-BY-NC-4.0 及全部上游来源或媒体条款；无法重建来源和再分发权利的记录应排除。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• For teams building reasoning SFT, knowledge distillation, and filtered self-training, pin the official revision, preserve source fields, train a fixed-backbone baseline, and output both a versioned mixture and domain-level metrics. The intervention succeeds only if the target gains survive a provenance and error audit.
  • For auditors, sample records by source and difficulty and replay question-quality judgments, reference-answer checks, reward-model scoring, and self-reward filtering. Produce a keep/reject ledger with failure reasons; do not use the dataset when licenses, task inputs, or verification artifacts are unavailable.

• 构建推理监督微调、知识蒸馏和过滤式自训练的团队应固定官方版本、保留来源字段、训练同骨干基线，并输出带版本的数据混合与分领域指标。只有目标收益通过来源和错误审计后，才算复用成功。
  • 数据审计者应按来源和难度抽样，重放问题质量判断、参考答案检查、奖励模型评分与自奖励筛选，输出带失败原因的保留与拒绝台账。许可、任务输入或验证产物缺失时不应使用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Positioning: NATURALREASONING scales domain-diverse question generation, attaches reference answers and named teacher responses, and exposes those records for distillation or self-training.
  • Data object: 2.8 million questions with reference answers and teacher responses; each record exposes question, reference_answer, and a list of response and response_model pairs.
  • Author and selector: Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and other named teacher models write long responses; retention uses question-quality judgments, reference-answer checks, reward-model scoring, and self-reward filtering.
  • Evidence anchor: On the paper's matched question-quality evaluation, NATURALREASONING obtains a mean score of 6.45 versus 5.92 for the second-best source, and its distillation studies improve broad reasoning benchmarks.
  • Reuse decision: suitable for reasoning SFT, knowledge distillation, and filtered self-training; first audit reference answers and reward-model scores can accept fluent but unsupported reasoning and synthetic expansion may reproduce teacher biases or uneven domain coverage.

• 定位：NATURALREASONING 把自然领域难题、参考答案和具名教师回答整理为 280 万条可蒸馏记录。
  • 数据对象：280 万个问题，并附参考答案和教师回答，单条记录包含问题、参考答案，以及带生成模型标识的回答列表。
  • 生成与筛选：Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 等具名教师模型生成长回答，并依据问题质量判断、参考答案检查、奖励模型评分与自奖励筛选保留。
  • 证据锚点：在论文的匹配问题质量评估中，该数据源均分为 6.45，第二名为 5.92；蒸馏实验还带来跨领域推理提升。
  • 复用决定：适合推理监督微调、知识蒸馏和过滤式自训练；先审计参考答案与奖励模型可能接受流畅但缺少依据的推理和合成扩展可能复制教师偏差，并造成领域覆盖不均。
